svg.title: Bulgaria study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Thracian Valley near Plovdiv; 2: Struma Valley near Melnik; 3: Danube Plain near Pleven; 4: Black Sea near Varna; 5: Rose Valley near Karlovo; 6: Sakar near Harmanli; 7: Sofia; 8: Burgas; 9: Ruse; 10: Stara Zagora; 11: Dobrich; 12: Khaskovo

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
